title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
hook_text: Figma just changed how AI builds code.
script:
Figma is launching new platform features to define how software agents operate.
Figma is releasing its new code layers feature in open beta today.
Designers use this new tool to control exactly how automated coding assistants read design files.
It gives engineering teams a way to structure layouts so AI generates much cleaner production code.
Figma also added twenty Model Context Protocol partners including Sarvam to expand its ecosystem.
Users can now ask an agent directly to turn a canvas design into working code.
Would you let an AI turn your Figma design into production code?
